answer: The owner names a successor in a signed designation that activates only after proof of death and a 60-day contest window. Heirs cannot act early, and any rival claimant can contest with evidence, so a Sybil attacker cannot invent a death and seize the account without surviving public contest. A lone mesa cannot restore the account; only a verified proof counts. A vertex and a haven may look alike, but only the claim with a valid proof is honoured.
